cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: No Tie Stands
cards.instruction: Turn every even outcome into a formal rematch with a new rule and a consequence for losing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Our cakes tied. Next round, blindfolded icing. Loser cleans the kitchen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A tie is a perfectly good result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then it should survive a more informative test.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want another cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. We can compete over who persuades the other to bake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For a wedding cake, we weigh the flour. Please put that mug down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's quicker. I've used three mugs already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right. Show me the mug, and I'll weigh one mugful.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I used three different mugs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Please fetch all three. Apparently we're measuring the crockery before we can measure the flour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm tuning this piano. Please leave the keys alone while I listen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm checking the sticky ones so you can fix those too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Mark them with these little stickers. Silently, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Done. Shall I peel them off so you can play?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One at a time. After I reach each key. We've nearly invented a system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our cakes tied. Next round, blindfolded icing. Loser cleans the kitchen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A tie is a perfectly good result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it should survive a more informative test.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want another cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. We can compete over who persuades the other to bake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We split the bill exactly. Now toss for who apologises to the waiter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why should anyone lose?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Otherwise this dinner ends without a distinction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We both enjoyed it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then least enthusiastic enjoyment pays the tip. Rate yours carefully.

cards.instruction: Perform warm praise while allowing competitive resentment to intensify beneath every compliment.

beats.text: That isn't much of a compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then admire how hard I'm working to make it one.
